sloka: निर्गुणं भ्रातरं त्यक्त्वा यो मां स्वयमुपस्थितः ।विभीषणस्य भक्तस्य सफलो ऽद्य परिश्रमः ।। ६.११८.९ ।।
transliteration: nirguṇaṁ bhrātaraṁ tyaktvā yo māṁ svayamupasthitaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇasya bhaktasya saphalo 'dya pariśramaḥ ।। 6.118.9 ।।

translations.english: "In the same way even Vibheeshana's hard work leaving his brother devoid of good qualities and coming to me on his own has given success."
